title: Google DeepMind Staff Push UK Body to Force a Union Vote
dek: Workers want a say on military AI contracts after talks with Google stalled.

facts.label: UK product staff covered by the bid
CWU and Unite filed with the CAC

caption:
Google DeepMind's own staff are taking their employer to a UK government body. ⚖️

The Communication Workers Union (CWU) and Unite the Union have asked the UK's Central Arbitration Committee to confirm they have enough support to trigger a formal union ballot at Google DeepMind. About 1,000 product-focused UK staff would be covered, and if the vote goes ahead, the company would be legally bound to respect the result.

The drive started in February 2025, when Alphabet dropped its pledge not to use AI for weapons. Workers object to deals with the US and Israeli militaries and want Google to back out of them. They say management refused to come to the table, so they went to the government instead.

At AI Parabellum we're watching closely: organizers hope staff at OpenAI and Anthropic follow, which could make this a template for worker power across the AI industry.

post_caption:
Could the team behind Gemini become one of the first top AI labs with a binding union? The CAC now decides whether roughly 1,000 Google DeepMind staff get a recognition ballot.

At the heart of it: worker objections to military AI contracts, and a demand for a say in how AI is built and deployed.
